cover: Where a person should sign off on AI work

slides.title: Check where mistakes get hard to undo
slides.body: Money moving, a customer message, a shared record changing. A person approves before any of those take effect.

slides.title: Let it read, sort and draft alone
slides.body: If the output is wrong and nothing has happened yet, the person who uses it later will notice.

slides.title: Some actions stay out of reach
slides.body: Deleting data or changing permissions isn't left to a prompt. The AI's permissions simply don't allow it.

slides.title: Design the review so people keep up
slides.body: Show the source beside the draft, make editing as easy as approving, and make unusual cases look different.

slides.title: Keep a record and a stop button
slides.body: Log what the AI saw and produced, and who approved it. Halt the queue automatically when errors pile up.

slides.title: Loosen checkpoints with evidence
slides.body: When the records show people almost never change a kind of output, let it through with spot checks.
